name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY) — Gujarat
amount: Up to ₹50,000 a year (degree); more for medical
description: Merit-cum-means support for students of all categories who are Gujarat residents and have taken admission in a Gujarat diploma or degree course. Family income up to ₹6 lakh. Fresh applicants need 80 percentile (not percentage) in Class 12 Science or General stream for degree courses, or in Class 10 for diploma. The deadline was extended; one report gives 30 Oct 2026, 6 PM, with document verification by 5 Nov — confirm on the portal. The document list below may be shorter than the portal's.
benefits: Tuition-fee assistance of up to ₹50,000 a year for degree courses (50% of tuition, whichever is lower) and up to ₹2 lakh for medical, plus hostel and book support in some cases.
